jobs.occupation: DFT Engineer (M, F, D) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

- You will create DFT specifications, create verification plans, and define the SoC test interface.
- You will develop and implement the DFT architecture and own its integration into large SoC blocks — including IP integration, system and control bus connectivity, and the integration of memories and hard macros.
- You will implement testbenches, generate directed and constrained-random tests, debug failures, run gate-level simulations, and close coverage.
- You will also generate structural test vectors, run synthesis and timing closure and work closely with Chip Architecture, DV, Physical Design, and Power teams to achieve first-tapeout success.
- Additional responsibilities include supporting STA, physical, power, and logical analysis for DFT modes, partnering with Test Engineers to bring up test vectors on silicon.

Minimum Qualifications

- B.Sc./M.Sc./PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Solid knowledge of industry-standard DFT practices, including ATPG, JTAG, MBIST, and the trade-offs between test quality and test time.
- Proficient in Verilog and/or VHDL, with hands-on experience using simulators and waveform debugging tools.
- Experience developing DFT specifications and driving DFT architecture and methods for designs.
- Proven understanding of design verification (DV) methodologies for validating DFT implementation in simulation pre-silicon.
- Proficient in a scripting language such as Python, TCL, or Perl, including familiarity or proficiency in leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate scripting and engineering workflows.
- Ability to fluently speak and write in English, including expressing complex technical concepts clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing DFT specifications and driving DFT architecture and methods for designs
- Proven Understanding of design verification (DV) methodologies for validating DFT implementation in simulation pre-silicon
- Experience debugging compressed ATPG patterns, MBIST, and JTAG/1500 related issues.
- Experience with STA constraints development and analysis for DFT modes, as well as SDF simulations.
- Ability to conduct experiments during silicon debug, gathering and analyzing data, and using scripting to support efficient handling of ATE data.
- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
- Experience in large SoC design or verification.

jobs.occupation: Design Verification Engineer for Cellular SoC (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Description

You will need a fundamental understanding of HW and SW design, as well as the eagerness to do hands-on verification. The cool thing is, once you crack the design verification world, it will potentiate your knowledge of HW/SW systems in the RF world. We will introduce you to assertion-based verification, simulation acceleration, and formal methods. You will learn special verification languages as universal verification methodology (UVM) or formal description languages, like SVA, flanked by AI-based approaches. Our team is a very strong cellular hardware design verification team with very good individual communication. You will work in a strong team setup with a lot of interpersonal interaction that will help you to get a very wide understanding of our work, as well as the sub-system and system integration into RF modems. You will build metric-driven verification plans from specifications, review them, and refine them to achieve coverage targets. You will define functional verification requirements based on design requirements and architect and develop UVM-based, highly reusable test benches starting from different components over a cluster into SoC levels.

Minimum Qualifications

- Proven experience in taping out SoC systems with embedded processor cores and hands-on verification experience in UVM environments.
- Strong collaborative work experience with system, design, and firmware teams.
- Verification and Validation approach, as well as outstanding sense and commitment to the quality of deliverables
- A detective skill for finding bugs and weaknesses
- Having a good view of the definition and design process of a chip
- Holistically thinking beyond the design verification domain boundaries
- Good interpersonal and communication skills
- English language proficiency is required for this position

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's (or higher degree) in Electrical Engineering or Communication Engineering with several years of working experience.
- System know-how in the cellular RF transceiver domain is a plus
- Proficiency in RISC-V architecture, encompassing design, verification, and programming, is highly valued
- Knowledge of assertion-based verification would be nice to have
- Ideally, you worked on system/IP definition, system/IP validation, system/IP design, system/IP testing, or similar
- Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We also take affirmative action to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all applicants, including minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities.

Your daily workout

- Secure-by-Design Enablement: You work closely with software engineering teams to integrate application security into design, development, and deployment processes
- Security Reviews: You perform and manage security reviews for major features, services, APIs, and critical applications
- Tooling & Automation: You design, introduce, and continuously improve application security tooling such as SAST and DAST, including CI/CD integration
- Vulnerability Management: You identify, validate, and help prioritize vulnerabilities across applications, APIs, and cloud-native environments, supporting teams with pragmatic remediation guidance
- Advisory & Consulting Role: You act as a trusted security advisor, translating security requirements and findings into practical, developer-friendly solutions
- Cloud & Platform Security: You collaborate with SRE, DevOps, and platform teams to improve security in containerized and cloud-native setups (e.g. Kubernetes, Docker, GCP/AWS)
- Security Awareness: You contribute to improving security awareness and knowledge across engineering teams through documentation, guidance, and hands-on support
- Continuous Improvement: You stay up to date with emerging threats, application security trends, and DevSecOps best practices
- Compliance & Certification Leadership: You lead technical readiness and evidence collection for security certifications (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001) and emerging regulatory requirements, ensuring the product ecosystem meets global security Standards
- Trust & Sales Enablement: You serve as the technical authority for security questionnaires, providing accurate and timely responses to prospects and clients to streamline the sales process and demonstrate compliance with customer security requirements

Your fitness level

- Professional Experience: You have several years of experience in Application Security, Software Security Engineering, or a closely related role
- Application Security Know-how: You have strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, secure coding principles, threat modeling, and security testing approaches such as SAST and DAST
- Technical Skills: You are comfortable working with modern software stacks and can read or write code (e.g. Go, Java, Python, or similar) to support reviews, PoCs, or tooling
- Cloud & DevSecOps Understanding: You are familiar with cloud-native architectures, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized environments
- Mindset: You enjoy working with engineers rather than acting as a gatekeeper
- Working Style: You work in a structured, pragmatic, and collaborative way and feel comfortable shaping processes in a greenfield environment
- Language Skills: You have professional proficiency in English

Your training goal for your first 6 months

- Understanding: You gain a deep understanding of our tech stack, development processes, and teams

- Impact: You drive and deliver individual application security projects derived from the aligned plan

jobs.occupation: Quality Inspector (m/f/d) Source Inspection - Aerospace (Prüfer/in von Luftfahrtgerät / Certifying Staff)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

The TRIGO Group provides quality services worldwide in over 28 countries, setting the highest standards for safety and mobility. Since 2013, TRIGO ADR Germany has been supporting the aerospace and rail industries in quality assurance, operating over 20 locations across Germany.

Our goal is to develop sustainable solutions with the highest quality standards, optimize processes, and drive innovation to consistently exceed our customers’ expectations.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented Quality Inspector (m/f/d) with a focus on Source Inspection for the aerospace sector. In this role, you will conduct supplier inspections across Europe, focusing on cabin, structural, and mechanical components.

Reference Number: 04-25

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Supplier Inspections (Source Inspection): Perform detailed inspections of aerospace components and materials directly at European suppliers to ensure compliance with technical specifications, industry standards, and regulatory requirements
- Documentation Review: Check and evaluate supplier documents such as inspection reports, material certificates, and conformity statements according to aerospace standards (e.g., AS9100, EN9100)
- Inspection Methods: Apply visual, dimensional, and functional testing methods using precise measuring instruments (e.g., micrometers, calipers, height gauges). Knowledge of non-destructive testing (NDT) methods (e.g., ultrasonic, eddy current) is a plus
- Supplier Communication & Audits: Collaborate closely with suppliers to ensure quality requirements are met and participate in audits and assessments to verify compliance with internal and international aerospace standards (e.g., EASA, FAA, FAI)
- Reporting & Documentation: Prepare accurate inspection reports, document deviations, corrective actions, and compliance evidence
- Product Lifecycle Support: Assist in evaluating new components regarding technical specifications, inspection requirements, and safety standards during the development phase

REQUIREMENTS

- Degree in a technical or engineering field, ideally with a focus on aerospace or mechanical engineering
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in quality inspection, preferably in aerospace or industrial manufacturing, ideally with a focus on Source Inspection and supplier quality
- Strong knowledge of common quality standards (AS9100, EN9100, ISO 9001)
- Confident handling of measuring and testing equipment (micrometers, calipers, height gauges, etc.)
- Knowledge of aerospace materials, manufacturing processes, and product specifications
- Understanding of European aerospace regulations and certification requirements (e.g., EASA)
- ASQ Certified Quality Inspector or equivalent certification, and/or approval as inspector by an aerospace OEM is desirable
- Basic training in AS/EN 9100 standards and Human Factors is a plus
- Additional qualifications in NDT (e.g., ultrasonic, eddy current) are an advantage
- High willingness to travel across Europe is mandatory
- Fluent German and/or English, both written and spoken; additional European languages (e.g., French, Spanish) are a plus

WHAT WE OFFER:

In addition to a permanent employment contract, we provide attractive benefits, including:

- 30 days of vacation
- Company pension scheme and capital-forming benefits
- Corporate fitness (Wellpass) and JobRad (bike leasing)
- Company health insurance
- Childcare allowance
- Discounts via Corporate Benefits

APPLY NOW! 

Do the described tasks appeal to you? Then we look forward to receiving your detailed CV! Please include the job title, reference number, and your salary expectations in your application.

For any questions, feel free to contact us by phone or email.

jobs.occupation: Space Safety System Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Contribute to the development of In-Orbit Servicing (IOS), Active Debris Removal (ADR), Rendezvous and Docking (RVD) missions and related applications
- Analyse customer, mission and system requirements, including functional analyses, specification tree development and identification of required design adaptations
- Perform requirements engineering activities, including the decomposition and allocation of requirements to platform and subsystem level using DOORS and Polarion
- Monitor compliance with system requirements, coordinate with the Project Chief Engineer and Project Management, and initiate appropriate corrective actions where necessary.
- Support trade-off analyses and contribute to the definition of mission and system architectures.
- Contribute to the design and development of space systems, covering mission design, system architecture, subsystem definition and technical specifications.
- Manage and maintain system-level engineering budgets, including performance, mass, power and data budgets.
- Support interface management and budget management within the assigned engineering domain
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of the system Concept of Operations (CONOPS)
- Coordinate technical activities across subsystems, including impact assessments resulting from requirement changes, under the guidance of the Project Chief Engineer
- Support the technical coordination and management of subcontractors
- Provide direct engineering support and technical reporting to the Project Chief Engineer
- Support key system engineering reviews, including PDR, CDR and verification planning activities
- Assist in the implementation of approved design changes and the management of engineering deviations and non-conformances, including RFWs, RFDs and NCRs
- Contribute to system and subsystem verification activities, including the definition of test plans, test procedures and the evaluation of test results
- Prepare and maintain project documentation by coordinating technical inputs and documenting assigned work packages
- Support the preparation of technical proposals and bids for ADR and in-orbit servicing missions
Your Qualifications

- You hold a degree in Aerospace Engineering or a comparable technical field and have gained several years of experience in Systems Engineering, ideally within the space industry or another high-tech environment
- You are familiar with the full engineering lifecycle, from requirements analysis and specification development to defining system architectures and managing interfaces across complex projects
- You enjoy working in multidisciplinary teams and are confident communicating with a wide range of technical stakeholders
- A structured, solution-oriented approach, combined with creativity and a collaborative mindset, enables you to successfully tackle complex engineering challenges
- Experience in Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) and Rendezvous & Docking (RvD) would be a valuable asset. Fluency in English is essential, while German language skills are considered a plus
